Topics covered in this PDF

BPVC-107 (Processing of Animal Produce) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Milk processing, cream separation, sterilization and UHT
  • Meat quality and hygienic handling, egg structure and nutrition, fish spoilage and chilling
  • Part B activities: local surveys and assessments of milk, meat, eggs and fish

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: attempt both parts, maximum marks 100
  • Part A: five questions, about 500 words each, 5 x 10 = 50 marks
  • Part B: six activities are listed; evidence of any five is to be submitted, 5 x 10 = 50 marks

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.

This PDF is study and reference material. Use it like this:

  • Learn the answer structure from the PDF: introduction, concept or facts, examples and conclusion
